Laukuva Second Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Tauragės apskritis, Lithuania

Not demolished. This is the second of Laukuva's two Jewish cemeteries, a companion to the first documented elsewhere in this collection, serving the same community. Jews began settling in Laukuva in the 18th century; the population reached 418 (55 percent) by 1897. Following the 1941 German invasion, Jewish men over 15 were taken to a labor camp and later sent to Auschwitz, while women and children were murdered in 1941; seven women and one child, hidden by Lithuanian peasants, survived.
